## History

During afternoon classes at [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teased [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by pulling her hair and calling her 'Carrots'. In response, an enraged [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) smashed her slate over his head.
